day_1.caller_text: Hello? I hope you've reached the right department. There is something strange happening in my kitchen. For the past three nights I have heard thumping footsteps.

I was outside late last night when I noticed something standing near the edge of my property. It looked almost human, but definitely wasn't. As soon as I looked directly at it, it made this horrible screeching sound and suddenly moved towards me.

Hi, I think something is wrong with my phone. There's these tiny little feet hanging out of the speaker, and I keep hearing this weird chipping sound whenever I pick it up. There's also this sticky trail on the handle.

I was walking home last night and saw something strange in the woods. It looked like a normal bird, except its eyes were glowing green. Everything around it was completely silent, and I noticed some strange three-clawed footprints on the ground.

day_2.caller_text: I think I've got a problem in my backyard. There are these tiny seeds everywhere and they're all moving with the wind. There's so many of them that I can see the swarm from quite far away. What should I do?

There's something weird going on in my kitchen. I've found small brown droppings underneath the sink, and last night I heard quiet rustling coming from behind the cupboards. There's also a really strange musty smell.

I was walking past the school yesterday when I noticed this grey bird following me around. It just kept staring at me. I found a bunch of grey feathers outside my classroom afterwards, and I could hear this strange bird-like chipping sound nearby.
